reasoning: On the season so far the Lakers are the stronger team; with home court the Lakers start about 10 points better, in a game of about 241 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Lakers win 78 times in 100, by about 10; most games like this end between 215 and 263 total points.
